On the back, in his dead wife’s hand, were the words: ‘It is for you, until you are ready to come home.’ Elias sat beside the great lens until dawn.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台调低音量的机器。高架桥上偶有货车驶过，灯光在湿漉漉的路面拖出长线；便利店的白光照着打盹的店员，也照着门外一桶未收的伞。环卫车慢慢转过街角，早点铺刚升起第一缕蒸汽。远处写字楼仍亮着几扇窗，像失眠者不肯合上的眼睛。风穿过空旷的站台，带来江水的潮气。天还未亮，夜色已经松动，第一班公交正从车场醒来，载着这座城市尚未说出的梦。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a nested set of boxes: you open one, then repeat the same steps for the smaller box inside.\n- You need a stopping rule, such as finding the tiniest empty box, so the process does not continue forever."}
